description: KrakenDEndpoint is the Schema for the krakendendpoints API.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: KrakenDEndpointSpec defines the desired state of KrakenDEndpoint.

componentSchemas.description:
ComponentSchemas holds OpenAPI component schemas referenced by endpoint
documentation/openapi ref fields. Each key is a lowercase schema name
and each value is the raw JSON Schema object. The renderer aggregates
these into the root-level documentation/openapi.components_schemas so
that each KrakenDEndpoint CR is self-contained.

endpoints.description: Endpoints is the list of endpoint definitions.

items.description: EndpointEntry defines a single KrakenD endpoint.

backends.description: Backends is the list of backend services for this endpoint.

items.description: BackendSpec defines a backend service target.

allow.description: Allow is the allowlist of response fields to keep.

deny.description: Deny is the denylist of response fields to remove.

disableHostSanitize.description:
DisableHostSanitize skips host protocol validation. Required for non-HTTP
protocols (amqp://, nats://, kafka://) or when using sd=dns.

encoding.description: Encoding selects the backend response encoding.

extraConfig.description: ExtraConfig holds arbitrary backend-level extra_config JSON.

group.description: Group wraps the backend response under a named key to avoid collisions.

host.description: Host is the list of backend host URLs.

inputHeaders.description: InputHeaders is the list of headers forwarded to this backend.

inputQueryStrings.description: InputQueryStrings is the list of query parameters forwarded to this backend.

isCollection.description: IsCollection marks that the backend returns an array instead of an object.

method.description: Method overrides the endpoint method for this backend.

policyRef.description: PolicyRef references a KrakenDBackendPolicy to apply.

sd.description: SD selects the service discovery provider (e.g. "static", "dns").

sdScheme.description: SDScheme sets the service discovery scheme (e.g. "http", "https").

target.description: Target extracts a nested object and returns only its contents.

urlPattern.description: URLPattern is the backend URL path pattern.

cacheTTL.description: CacheTTL overrides the global cache TTL.

concurrentCalls.description:
ConcurrentCalls sets the number of concurrent backend calls for this endpoint.
When specified, it must be a positive integer.

endpoint.description: Endpoint is the public path exposed by KrakenD (e.g. "/api/v1/users").

extraConfig.description: ExtraConfig holds arbitrary endpoint-level extra_config JSON.

inputHeaders.description: InputHeaders is the list of headers forwarded to backends.

inputQueryStrings.description: InputQueryStrings is the list of query string parameters forwarded to backends.

method.description: Method is the HTTP method for this endpoint.

outputEncoding.description: OutputEncoding overrides the default response encoding.

timeout.description: Timeout overrides the global endpoint timeout.

gatewayRef.description: GatewayRef references the KrakenDGateway this endpoint belongs to.

status.description: KrakenDEndpointStatus defines the observed state of KrakenDEndpoint.

items.description: Condition contains details for one aspect of the current state of this API Resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
lastTransitionTime is the last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.
This should be when the underlying condition changed.  If that is not known, then using the time when the API field changed is acceptable.

message.description:
message is a human readable message indicating details about the transition.
This may be an empty string.

observedGeneration.description:
observedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description:
reason contains a programmatic identifier indicating the reason for the condition's last transition.
Producers of specific condition types may define expected values and meanings for this field,
and whether the values are considered a guaranteed API.
The value should be a CamelCase string.
This field may not be empty.

status.description: status of the condition, one of True, False, Unknown.

type.description: type of condition in CamelCase or in foo.example.com/CamelCase.
